notes.title: Development Paused Indefinitely
notes.content:
I have decided to stop development on Battle Bros. 

I am only a single developer working on this project and life is getting too much in the way for me to continue the game. I don't have any current plans to revisit and finish this project, but I may come back to it in the future to finish what I started.

Thanks to everyone who wishlisted the game to this point, and feel free to wishlist the game still in the event I do come back to finish it.
